identityProposal.pattern: tva-public:<canonical decoded final URL path segment>
identityProposal.meaning: Publisher page locator, not native engineering project ID; preserve exact canonical slug and explicit crosswalks for later URL/phase changes.
identityProposal.gisIds: Some public GIS PROJECT_ID values are established as linked-layer aliases only. Partial geometry and program scope prevent automatic whole-page identity promotion.

fieldMappingProposal.owner: null initially for page/program scope; TVA publisher/builder and separate utility substation ownership do not automatically establish a single complete proposed asset owner
fieldMappingProposal.sourceState: Preserve explicitly stated project state text; index grouping alone is incomplete for cross-state projects. Diagnostic placements identify source sections, not a geocoded jurisdiction.
fieldMappingProposal.lifecycle: Latest explicit dated update: planned for proposals/preferred routes, on-hold for explicit holds, under-construction only for actual construction evidence; no calendar-based completion
fieldMappingProposal.dates: Retain exact raw seasonal text. A single explicitly named year may be represented at year precision with season preserved in label; cross-year winter ranges, contradictory dates and withdrawn/hold schedules remain unknown primary dates. Separate component forecasts do not become a fabricated common completion date.
fieldMappingProposal.sourceUpdatedOn: null for month-only page updates; month preserved in lifecycleAsOf/source-edition and raw notes. Snapshot observation is used for undated pages.
fieldMappingProposal.construction: Forecast construction seasons and completed surveys/easements are not an actual construction start or complete construction window.
fieldMappingProposal.location: null; nativeGeometry null and centerRole unknown in initial ingestion; public polyline routes are not point centers. No map-image interpretation or geocoding.
